title: The Results Announcement
gist_ar: إعلان في مدرسة عن نتايج شهر القراءة، ومين قرا أكتر، وتغيير مواعيد المكتبة.

before_listening.en: A school announcement before the first lesson. Listen for what the school has DECIDED to change.
before_listening.ar: إعلان في مدرسة قبل أول حصة. ركّز على إيه اللي المدرسة قرّرت تغيّره.

segments.speaker: Head teacher
segments.text: Good morning, everyone. Before the first lesson, here are the results of our reading month. This was the best month we have ever had. The class that read the most books is 2B, with ninety-one books. The longest book was read by Yusuf: four hundred pages, finished in nine days. The most popular book in the whole school was The Blue Door. But the hardest part, students told us, was finding a quiet time to read at home. So we have made a decision. From next week the library will open earlier, at seven thirty in the morning, and it will stay open until four in the afternoon. Well done, everybody. 2B, please come to the hall at ten.

gist_question.q: What has the school decided to do?
options: Give 2B a prize instead of a trip
Open the library earlier and close it later
Ask students to read only at home

questions.q: Which class read the most books?
What was the hardest part for students?
options: Finding a quiet time to read at home
